rule: |CAGR(harness parent) - CAGR(published parent)| <= 1.00 pp/yr on all 4 books
diagnosis: No split/bonus artefacts: no held name moves beyond +/-25% in a day. On a common calendar the gap splits in two. (1) Index convention: the published index moves to the new basket on availableDate with its own execution prices, and the day's return is attributed differently depending on the convention (+/-2-3 pp/yr swing across conventions tested; no single one fits all four books). About half to two-thirds of the published-minus-replica gap sits on the ~39 rebalance sessions. It cannot be reproduced without the platform's fills. (2) Execution cadence: the harness picks up a new parent basket at the next Friday review and fills on the next session, exactly like the live AA books (which execute on Mondays after the review, and in 2022-23 often weeks later). That lag is a real cost that every simulated strategy shares; it is not a harness error.
